_about: Evolutions and species facts by national number, from PokeAPI's CSV dump (master, 15 Oct 2026). Evolution rows: 'vg' = PokeAPI version group where the method starts; from_form/to_form = PokeAPI form identifiers (null: no form required / default form); region = PokeAPI region where this row applies. Species: egg = what breeding it gives (null: cannot breed), egg groups, gender_rate (-1 genderless, 0 male only, 8 female only), baby, legendary, mythical.
